outline.title: More Variants of Merger and Division (Neurath, Coleridge, Bergson, Othello, classification)

concepts.label: Dialectic in the most general sense
concepts.gloss: the employment of the possibilities of linguistic transformation; broader than dramatistic, since it includes non-dramatistic idioms

concepts.label: Transformation of terms
concepts.gloss: the master apparatus of GM-09: tracking the disposition and trans-position of terms across motive-statements; the way ancestral, derivative, and bridge terms migrate, merge, split, or get re-keyed under dialectical pressure

concepts.label: Linguistic transformation (general study)
concepts.gloss: Burke distinguishes (a) general study of transformation-possibilities (e.g. the pentad as such) from (b) particular instances (e.g. critic on one work)

concepts.label: Merger
concepts.gloss: the comprehension of scattered particulars in one idea (Plato, Phaedrus); the basic dialectical move toward unity/homogeneity/genus

concepts.label: Division
concepts.gloss: carving an idea at the joints, not breaking any part (Plato, Phaedrus); the basic dialectical move toward distinction/heterogeneity/species

concepts.label: Third / pontificating term
concepts.gloss: Burke's claim that any merger-division dialectic generates a need for a tertium quid (Kant's continuity, Bell's mathematical third, Coleridge's polarity)

concepts.label: Paradox of substance (in dialectical key)
concepts.gloss: the offspring is substantially one with the parent yet apart from the parent; merger-and-division operate jointly on the same term; recapitulated from GM-02 and recast as a dialectical staple

concepts.label: Dialectic of the scapegoat
concepts.gloss: the structured three-step ritual (original merger -> ritualistic division/alienation -> new merger of the purified) by which a charismatic vicar absorbs and carries off the collective iniquities of a community; the dialectical engine of vicarious atonement

concepts.label: Scapegoat as charismatic vicar
concepts.gloss: the scapegoat is profoundly consubstantial with its persecutors because it is their chosen vessel; cleansing works by loading their own iniquities onto it

concepts.label: Christian atonement / Anti-Semitism contrast
concepts.gloss: Christian dialectic of atonement is more complex than the paradigm; Hitlerite Anti-Semitism is the cleanest negative example — scapegoat as the essence of evil, the principle of discord

concepts.label: Honor / frustrated scapegoating
concepts.gloss: when division is frustrated (cannot be projected outward) the motives of self-destruction must come to the fore — Burke's account of Nazi 'honor'

concepts.label: Per genus et differentiam
concepts.gloss: the classical scholastic definition (genus + specific difference) read as dialectical operation: merger via genus + division via differentia; the seed of all classification

concepts.label: Haecceitas (Scotist thisness)
concepts.gloss: the third stage of characterization after generic and specific — the particular way of the individual; a merger of all three layers

concepts.label: Generic vs. specific essence of man
concepts.gloss: defining man as 'animal' (generic) vs. 'rational' (specific) vs. 'money-maker' (technological specific essence); reducing motivation to one aspect commits the perfectionistic fallacy

concepts.label: Synusia (Neurath)
concepts.gloss: Otto Neurath's term for the cohesive co-presence of beings + environment; example of a 'merger principle atop division' deployed in social science

concepts.label: Polarity (Coleridge)
concepts.gloss: Coleridge's formal pair (in Theory of Life): identity, duality, polarity, synthesis, indifference, predominance — Burke uses these as the formal vocabulary of merger-division variants

concepts.label: Substitution / equating (Spinozist)
concepts.gloss: the dialectical resource by which one of an equated pair drops out — Spinoza's God/nature collapsing to nature; Augustine reading evil as deficient good

concepts.label: Inter res heterogeneas non datur oppositio (Coleridge)
concepts.gloss: no opposition obtains between heterogeneous things; rivals are opposite banks of the same stream — the formal condition for dialectical opposition

concepts.label: Synonymizing / desynonymizing
concepts.gloss: the strategic choice between collapsing two terms as same or stretching them apart as different — anticipatory effect on conclusions

concepts.label: The Hegelian Insofern / Spinozist quatenus
concepts.gloss: the 'insofar as' operator that lets one divide what is empirically indivisible — the Socratic dialectical resource enabling artist-as-artist, ruler-as-ruler

concepts.label: Classification is essentially dialectical
concepts.gloss: scientific classification rests on similarity-difference; invariants of mathematics derive from where the dialectician draws the merger-division line; even 'events' are idealized via dialectical carving

concepts.label: Mind-body pair
concepts.gloss: the basic dualistic pair: apposition / opposition / one primary one derivative / both as aspects of a third — rhetorical leverage to 'idealize one's own cause while materializing the opponent's'

concepts.label: Being-nothing pair (essence-existence)
concepts.gloss: the pair whose most prevalent form is essence-existence; either member can be selected as 'reality' — Plato chooses being, Santayana flux, historicism becoming vs. having-become

concepts.label: Action-passion pair
concepts.gloss: the pair localizable as peace-war, love-hate, love-death, cooperation-competition; gives the resources of actus-status (status = the properties accompanying the act)

concepts.label: Actus and status (action-passion derivation)
concepts.gloss: from the action-passion pair Burke recovers the Stance-family + Power-family of substance-vocabulary developed in GM-02; enactments survive as constitutions

concepts.label: Distinction becomes contrast
concepts.gloss: when a synecdochic part (representative of the whole) becomes divisive with respect to the whole — the generic dialectical move that drives transcendence; e.g. nobility -> bourgeoisie

concepts.label: Socratic transcendence
concepts.gloss: the upward dialectical move: a new motive discovered en route; the position at the end is reached by transformation, and the position at the start can only retrospectively be seen in light of the new motivation. Burke reads Platonic dialogues themselves as acts of transcendence, not just pleas for it

concepts.label: Phaedrus as five-level transcendence
concepts.gloss: Burke's worked reading of the Phaedrus: Lysias' speech (false rhetoric) -> Socrates' first speech (deeper moral but same conceit) -> Socrates' second speech (impassioned celebration of love, Eros/Anteros) -> formal appreciation of the dialectical principles -> spoken word over written word

concepts.label: Feast of discourse (juncture of two levels)
concepts.gloss: the Phaedrus' opening 'feast' figure as the bodily-discursive juncture where the dialogue's transcendence begins; food/love/hunger as cluster at the roots of purpose

concepts.label: Verbal insemination / spoken-word seed
concepts.gloss: Socrates as 'corruptor of youth' in the transcendental sense — pedagogy as dialectical insemination, the spoken word as the seed; Yeats' Annunciation 'through the hollow of an ear'

concepts.label: Corruptor of youth (transcendental sense)
concepts.gloss: the charge against Socrates re-read dialectically: 'corruption' is the transcendence of the tribal/biological order — and the citizens who condemned him were themselves transcending, choosing him as their 'representative' victim

concepts.label: Socrates as scapegoat of transcendence
concepts.gloss: the principal interlock of GM-09: the dialectic of the scapegoat operating on the theorist of transcendence himself — Socrates dies that Plato and Aristotle (and ultimately Hellenistic imperialism + Christianity) may live

concepts.label: Phaedrus / Republic / Laws as dialectical series
concepts.gloss: Burke reads the three dialogues as a transformation-series: Phaedrus = dissolution of tribal homogeneity; Republic = idealistic reclamation of tribal concept on a higher level; Laws = brought-down-to-the-business of legislation

concepts.label: Mathematics as dialectical discipline (Title of Titles)
concepts.gloss: the Platonist treatment of mathematics: imagery transcended in generalization until 'a Title of Titles' is reached; Faraday's unified-energy formula as 'perfect god-term'

concepts.label: Title of Titles / god-term
concepts.gloss: the limit of dialectical transcendence: a summarizing term so general that it dispenses with all specific motivational problems — open to Galileo's objection that 'explaining everything explains nothing'

concepts.label: Temporizing of essence (KEY)
concepts.gloss: the pun on sequence: the logically prior can be expressed as temporally prior, and vice versa. Essence becomes narrated as a 'going back' to origins (Freud's primal horde, Plato's Meno-recollection, original sin); historicist vocabularies are convertible with essentialist vocabularies

concepts.label: Growing-out-of phraseology (Neurath)
concepts.gloss: Neurath's proposal to replace cause-effect language with growing-out-of language; convertible reading: 'derived from' satisfies temporalist and essentialist simultaneously

concepts.label: Freud's primal horde as essence-via-existence-claim
concepts.gloss: Freud's historicist vocabulary obliged him to project the family-essence into a past existent; anthropological discrediting of the existent does not necessarily discredit the essence

concepts.label: Meno-recollection as storial essence
concepts.gloss: Plato's doctrine that knowledge is innate / remembered from past existence is a 'storial' way of stating essential knowledge — paradigm case of temporizing essence

concepts.label: Original sin convertible to essential sin
concepts.gloss: the doctrine of original sin can be translated from historical-legendary terms ('our lineal descent from murderers') to essential terms ('man as essentially transgressor')

concepts.label: Peer Gynt as worked time-essence example
concepts.gloss: Ibsen's Peer Gynt is Burke's central worked case: a character in search of his true self, dramatized as 'going back' to the maternal/familial origin through Solveig as spiritualized mother — the Christ-child translation of an essential self via storial form

concepts.label: Temporizing as rhetorical leverage
concepts.gloss: a person against some policy absolutely may assert he objects to it 'now'; temporizing on the rhetorical level lets categorical convictions function as day-by-day alliances under ever-changing conditions (Zweck im Recht)

concepts.label: Dissolution of drama (four ways)
concepts.gloss: (1) act -> lyric state; (2) reducing action to motion; (3) philosophies of 'dramatism' itself (Burke's own move — coordinates derived from drama but used non-dramatically); (4) philosophies of 'super-drama' (monotheistic god -> impersonal)

concepts.label: Dramatistic perspective abolishes itself in its own enunciation
concepts.gloss: the structural paradox: dramatism's permanent interrelations are 'principles of development' that cannot themselves develop; the perspective must contain a point at which it abolishes itself

concepts.label: Neo-liberal / Neo-Stoic attitude
concepts.gloss: the closing program: linguistic skepticism = linguistic appreciation; an attitude embodied in a method, aimed at the 'purification of war'; tempered between dissipation (local opportunism) and fanaticism (one-terminology imperialism)

concepts.label: Purification of war
concepts.gloss: Burke's overarching ethical purpose for the Grammar: encouraging tolerance through speculation, finding what rival doctrines of motives share in common

concepts.label: Attitude (1962 Addendum)
concepts.gloss: in the Addendum for the Present Edition Burke proposes 'attitude' as a possible 6th pentad term — designating manner (quo modo) as distinct from agency (quibus auxiliis); allows scene-attitude ratio + agent-attitude ratio

concepts.label: Order of terms in a ratio matters
concepts.gloss: Addendum clarification: scene-act = effect of scene on act; act-scene = effect of act on scene; sometimes only a state of conformity without cause/effect (Conrad's Victory volcano)

concepts.label: All ratios are essentially analogies
concepts.gloss: Addendum closing note: by scene-act ratio Burke means the nature of the act is implicit / analogously present in the nature of the scene, etc.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Transformation of Terms
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: Master apparatus. To analyze any motive-statement dialectically, identify (a) which terms are ancestral, (b) which are derivative, (c) which possess bridging ambiguities that allow disposition (alignment) or transposition (swap) of the rest of the terms.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: The pentad itself as a generating principle resembling Kantian transcendentalism: the five pentadic ratios name forms necessarily exemplified in the imputing of human motives.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Cross-cuts all five terms; pentadic ratios are themselves transformation-vocabulary in miniature.
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: When a game-studies theory migrates a key term (e.g. 'immersion' migrates between agent-feature and scene-feature), this is a Burkean transformation-of-terms event.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Merger and Division
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: The two fundamental dialectical operations. Merger = comprehension of scattered particulars in one idea (Plato, Phaedrus). Division = carving an idea at its joints. Most concrete dialectical events are mergers atop division or divisions atop merger; a 'third / pontificating term' (continuity, polarity, synthesis) is usually generated to mediate.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Spencer's evolutionary movement from homogeneity to heterogeneity; Kant's three-fold homogeneity / specification / continuity; Bell's mathematics of continuity vs. discreteness; the paradox of substance (offspring as merger-then-division of parent).
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Scene as containing scene-of-scenes (merger) vs. scene-as-distinct-from-act (division); applies to every pentad term and every ratio.
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: Every typological move in game studies — genres, modes, mechanics-vs-narrative — is a merger-division move. The dissertation must name the implicit third / pontificating term.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Dialectic of the Scapegoat
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: Three-step ritual: (1) original merger — iniquities shared between iniquitous and chosen vessel; (2) division — ritualistic alienation of the shared element onto the vessel; (3) new merger — the purified community defined in dialectical opposition to the sacrificial offering. The scapegoat is consubstantial with persecutors (charismatic vicar); its 'curative' power resides only in that consubstantiality.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Hitlerite Anti-Semitism (scapegoat as essence of evil; bad-parent figure); Christian atonement (more complex paradigm); the debunker as closer to debunked than others are; Ahab and the white whale; the physician who is a bit sickly himself; Socrates as scapegoat of transcendence.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Agent (the scapegoat IS the agent who carries collective motive); Act (the sacrificial act); Scene (the community-as-scene gets re-keyed by the ritual); Purpose (purification).
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: A first-class apparatus for analyzing in-game antagonists, boss-fights, villain-design — and external moral panic about games themselves (games-as-scapegoat for cultural anxieties). The three-step is portable verbatim.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Per Genus et Differentiam
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: The scholastic definitional formula read as a dialectical operation: merger via genus + division via specific differentia + (Scotist) thisness as the third merger of all three layers. Reduction to generic essence is the materialist temptation; reduction to specific essence is the perfectionist / scientist temptation; both commit the principle-of-specification violation when terms get borrowed from the wrong field.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Aristotle's 'man = rational animal' (genus animal + differentia rational); Scotist haecceitas as the individual's particular way of being; the dramatic-unities cult as overstress on specification (lost Aristotelian epic context); modern definition of man as 'money-maker' / 'tool-user' as smuggled-in specific essences from technology and finance.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Substance vocabulary (GM-02); Agent (the defined entity); Act (the rational/animal/specific acting).
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: When game studies defines 'game' (Suits/Juul/Salen-Zimmerman) it operates per genus et differentiam — the dissertation can audit which differentia is featured and whether it has been smuggled from a non-game field.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Mind-Body Pair (antithetical)
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: A localized merger-division resource. The pair can be (a) in apposition, (b) in opposition, (c) one primary / one derivative, (d) both as aspects of an underlying ground. Rhetorical leverage: idealize one's own cause as mind, materialize the opponent's as body.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Either term can represent the other (physicalist or idealist reductions readily available); ground-of-both moves (psychosomatic medicine).
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Scene (body-as-scene) vs. Agent (mind-as-agent); the pair underlies the scene-agent ratio.
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: Game-studies dualisms — interface vs. mind, controller vs. cognition, embodied-cognition vs. computational-cognition — are mind-body pair variants.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Being-Nothing Pair (essence-existence)
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: The pair whose most prevalent form is essence vs. existence. Either member can be selected as 'reality.' Plato selects being (essences as substantial; existing things share with non-existents); Santayana selects flux; historicist frames: becoming vs. having-become.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Plato's Eleatic-Zenonian paradoxes; Santayana's variant of Platonism; the one-and-the-many (omnia ubique microcosm-macrocosm); fossilization as having-become.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Cuts across pentad — being often featured as the deep ground of Purpose (mysticism); essence-existence convertibility is the engine of temporizing-of-essence.
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: When game-studies asks 'what IS a game' (essence) vs. 'how do games come to be' (existence/becoming), the being-nothing pair is operating. The dissertation can flip vocabularies.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Action-Passion Pair
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: Localizable as peace-war, love-hate, love-death (Wagnerian), cooperation-competition. Indirect path back to substance: action-passion -> actus and status -> properties accompanying the act -> Stance-family + Power-family of GM-02. Enactments survive as constitutions (cross-link to GM-08).
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Theories of psychogenic illness (commingling action-passion + mind-body); evil as division ('Legion'); explicit-implicit / conscious-unconscious treated as action-passion variants (potentiality-actuality bearing).
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Act + Agent (status = agent's accompanying properties); foundation of dramatistic substance-vocabulary.
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: Player-input (action) vs. game-response (passion) is a baseline action-passion pair. The dissertation can audit which game-studies theories featurize action and which featurize passion.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Socratic Transcendence
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: The upward dialectical move: a new motive discovered en route. The position at the end transcends the position at the start, so that the start can only retrospectively be reinterpreted in light of the new motivation. Crucially: a Platonic dialogue is itself an ACT of transcendence, not merely a plea for one. Jowett saw transcendence 'from without' (as jolt/inconsistency); Burke reads it 'from within' (as the dialogue's structure).
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Burke's five-level reading of the Phaedrus (Lysias false rhetoric -> Socrates' first speech -> impassioned love-speech -> formal appreciation of dialectic -> spoken-over-written-word); Republic divided into Books I-IV (Hellenic state) + V-X (transformed ideal kingdom); Faraday's energy-formula as Title of Titles; mathematics as imagery-transcending dialectic.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Purpose (transcendence as upward purpose toward the One/Good); Act (the dialogue itself as transcending act).
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: When a game-studies framework arrives at a 'higher' or 'meta' level (procedural rhetoric -> rhetorics of failure; immersion -> incorporation), the transformation is Socratic transcendence: the start is reinterpreted from the end.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Temporizing of Essence (KEY)
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: The pun on sequence: the logically prior can be expressed as the temporally prior, and vice versa. Essence becomes narrated as a 'going back' to origins; historicist and essentialist vocabularies are convertible. Translation rule: when an apparently empirical-historical claim is discredited as fact, ask whether it was really a statement about essence; conversely, when an essential claim seems unfalsifiable, ask whether it has been smuggled out of a temporal vocabulary.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Freud's primal horde (essence smuggled into existence-claim); Plato's Meno-recollection (essential knowledge as storial 'remembering past existence'); original sin -> essential sin; Ibsen's Peer Gynt as a dramatic search for essence narrated as 'going back' to the mother; Proust's involuntary memory as the essayistic culmination — moments separated in time linked outside time by their idealized synthesizing quality.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: Scene-as-temporal-circumference (origin scenes); Act (the narrated act recovers essence); Agent (Peer's essence as a returned-to maternal grounding); cross-link to GM-13 (this is the trope of synecdoche operating dialectically — part-for-whole = origin-for-essence).
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: When game-design theory tells origin-stories of 'the first game' or grounds essence in evolutionary play (Huizinga), this is temporizing of essence. Dissertation can run the translation in both directions.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Distinction Becomes Contrast
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: When a synecdochic part (representative of the whole) becomes divisive with respect to the whole of which it was a part. The threshold-crossing where a representative element passes into an antithetical role — the generic engine of transcendence and of historical class-conflict.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: The nobility — formerly representative of feudal society — becoming antithetical to the society of trade (which itself becomes embourgeoisé).
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: When a representative game (e.g. Tetris-as-representative-of-puzzle) becomes a divisive marker (Tetris-as-NOT-narrative), the dialectical engine is identical.

transformation_vocabulary.label: Dissolution of Drama (four ways)
transformation_vocabulary.operational_gloss: The dramatistic perspective contains a point at which it abolishes itself in its own enunciation. Four canonical paths: (1) drama dissolves into lyric state (statūs reciprocal of actus); (2) action reduced to motion (scientism); (3) philosophies OF dramatism — Burke's own move — coordinates derived from drama yet used non-dramatically; (4) philosophies of super-drama — monotheistic god as super-person becomes impersonal.
transformation_vocabulary.burke_example: Burke's own pentad as case (3); scholastic theology's monotheism preparing the secular terminologies of science as case (4); Korzybski's two-valued non-Aristotelian as itself a two-valued orientation.
transformation_vocabulary.pentad_cross_link: All five — dissolution is the limit-condition of the pentad as such.
transformation_vocabulary.dissertation_handle: Game studies dissolves into game-as-system (motion), game-as-text (lyric), game-as-economy (super-drama), and meta-game-studies (case 3, the recursive self-abolition). Dissertation can name which path a given theory walks.

positions.claim: Dialectic in the most general sense is broader than dramatistic — it includes non-dramatistic idioms (lyric, scientist, mystical) — and the chapter's task is to expose the dialectical apparatuses that operate even outside dramatistic framing.

Any merger-division pair generates pressure toward a third / pontificating term (Kantian continuity, Bell's mathematical third, Coleridge's polarity); two-valued dialectics are unstable, and the discovery of the third is structural, not accidental.

The scapegoat is profoundly consubstantial with its persecutors; its 'curative' efficacy depends entirely on that prior consubstantiality — scapegoating is dialectical (three-step ritual), not mere projection.

A Platonic dialogue is not merely a plea FOR transcendence; it is an ACT of transcendence whose structure (Phaedrus' five levels) embodies what it argues. This is Burke's central correction of Jowett: transcendence must be read 'from within,' not 'from without.'

Socrates' execution is the dialectic of the scapegoat operating on the theorist of transcendence himself: the Athenians who condemned him were themselves transcending tribal-biological allegiance, and chose him as their representative victim because he most fully embodied the cultural movement they were enacting.

Historicist and essentialist vocabularies are mutually convertible by the temporizing-of-essence operator: any apparent statement about origins can be re-read as a statement about essence and vice versa.

The dramatistic perspective necessarily contains a point at which it abolishes itself in its own enunciation, because its 'principles of development' cannot themselves develop; one must therefore continually rediscover this self-abolition.

Attitude (quo modo, the manner of an act) can be added as a sixth pentad term, distinct from agency (quibus auxiliis, the means); ratios such as scene-attitude and agent-attitude then become available.
positions.centrality: addendum / forward-anchor to Rhetoric of Motives

positions.claim: Linguistic skepticism, properly developed, IS linguistic appreciation; the Grammar's purpose is an attitude ('neo-Stoic resignation' / 'neo-liberal speculation') aimed at the 'purification of war' through tolerance enabled by tracing rival doctrines back to their shared Edenic linguistic ground.

philosophers_cited.name: Plato
philosophers_cited.role: Source of the merger/division definitions (Phaedrus); subject of Burke's worked five-level dialogue-reading; the Phaedrus/Republic/Laws series as Burke's exemplar of a dialectical-historical transformation.

philosophers_cited.name: Socrates
philosophers_cited.role: Burke's principal figure of transcendence — and of being-victim-to-one's-own-transcendence (scapegoat of transcendence).

philosophers_cited.name: Aristotle
philosophers_cited.role: Per genus et differentiam definition; the lost epic-section of the Poetics as cautionary tale of dialectical de-contextualization; the post-Plato adjustment of the Socratico-Platonic 'impious' transcendence.

philosophers_cited.name: Aquinas
philosophers_cited.role: Univocal vs. equivocal derivation, agent-effect distinction (work pre-exists virtually in the workman as efficient cause).

philosophers_cited.name: Hegel
philosophers_cited.role: The 'Hegelian Insofern' (like Spinoza's quatenus) as the dialectical resource for dividing what is empirically indivisible.

philosophers_cited.name: Kant
philosophers_cited.role: Transcendental Dialectic (Critique of Pure Reason): merger/division/continuity as three principles; pentad as Kantian-transcendentalist generating principle; signs as signs.

philosophers_cited.name: Spinoza
philosophers_cited.role: God-nature equation as paradigm substitution; quatenus operator.

philosophers_cited.name: Augustine
philosophers_cited.role: Evil as deficiency of good — the dialectical move where one of an opposed pair is reduced to derivative status.

philosophers_cited.name: Bergson
philosophers_cited.role: Creative Evolution: Ammophila-and-caterpillar sympathy; instinct/intuition (merger) vs. intellect/cinematographical (division).

philosophers_cited.name: Freud
philosophers_cited.role: Totem and Taboo / Group Psychology — primal horde as paradigm of temporizing-of-essence (historicist vocabulary forced by Darwinism, but the underlying claim is essential).

philosophers_cited.name: Coleridge
philosophers_cited.role: Theory of Life: identity/duality/polarity/synthesis/indifference/predominance as the formal vocabulary of merger-division variants; inter res heterogeneas non datur oppositio (rivals as opposite banks of the same stream); unity-vs-multeity reading of per genus et differentiam.

philosophers_cited.name: Marx
philosophers_cited.role: Implicit via Coleridge / Neurath; historical dialectic backdrop (light).

philosophers_cited.name: Neurath (Otto)
philosophers_cited.role: Foundations of the Social Sciences: synusia (bio-ecological merger); growing-out-of phraseology as alternative to cause-effect; pluri-Cromwell.

philosophers_cited.name: Otto Bell (Eric T.)
philosophers_cited.role: The Handmaiden of the Sciences / Procedures: mathematical continuity-vs-discreteness as the merger-division pair; tertium quid; idealization in setting up equations.

philosophers_cited.name: Korzybski
philosophers_cited.role: Non-Aristotelian two-valued orientation as itself a two-valued orientation — paradigm dissolution of drama.

philosophers_cited.name: Santayana
philosophers_cited.role: Variant of Platonism: substantial flux of existence vs. essences as 'things sharing with non-existents.'

philosophers_cited.name: Otto Jowett (Benjamin)
philosophers_cited.role: Burke's principal interlocutor in the Socratic Transcendence subsection; Jowett saw transcendence 'from without,' Burke reads it 'from within.'

philosophers_cited.name: Proust
philosophers_cited.role: Remembrance of Things Past as essayistic culmination of temporizing essence; involuntary memory as moments linked outside time.

philosophers_cited.name: Lenzen (Victor F.)
philosophers_cited.role: Procedures of Empirical Science: partition between object and observer as affected by instrument-use (stick-as-part-of, stick-as-apart-from); classification as similarity-difference.

philosophers_cited.name: Lovejoy (Arthur)
philosophers_cited.role: Great chain of being as continuity-with-contradiction; cited for Kant's third principle.

philosophers_cited.name: Galileo
philosophers_cited.role: Cited for the rebuke that explaining everything explains nothing — limit-objection to the Title-of-Titles.

philosophers_cited.name: Aeschylus / Mann / Yeats
philosophers_cited.role: Death in Venice / Tadzio / The Mother of God — modern echoes of the Phaedrus pattern (corruption-as-saving-souls; Annunciation through-the-ear).

interlocutors.description: Implicit backdrop; explicit only via the 'Hegelian Insofern' and via Coleridge's polarity vocabulary. Marx himself nearly absent in this chapter (cf. GM-05/GM-08 for density).

interlocutors.label: Scholastic logic
interlocutors.description: Per genus et differentiam plus Scotist haecceitas; Aquinas on univocal/equivocal derivation; Aristotelian inheritance via medieval channels.

interlocutors.label: Kantian transcendental dialectic
interlocutors.description: Critique of Pure Reason as the immediate post-classical paradigm; Kant's three principles map onto Burke's merger/division/third-term schema.

tensions.tension: Dialectic-in-general is broader than dramatistic (it accommodates non-dramatistic idioms), yet the chapter is the closing theoretical chapter of a book titled Grammar of Motives whose method is explicitly dramatistic. The chapter must therefore dissolve drama from within drama — Burke's 'Dissolution of Drama' subsection names this paradox explicitly.

Merger and division are presented as co-primary, yet many of the worked examples (scapegoat, per-genus, distinction-becomes-contrast) tilt toward division as the dynamic engine and merger as the stable ground. Coleridge's identity → duality → polarity sequence reads as a one-way generation rather than a symmetrical pair.

Socratic transcendence is the upward dialectical move; the dialectic of the scapegoat is a downward / outward purgation. Yet the Socrates-as-scapegoat-of-transcendence reading shows them operating jointly: the upward move generates a scapegoat-victim from its own representative figure. Are they two apparatuses or one apparatus seen from two sides?

If historicist and essentialist vocabularies are fully convertible (temporizing of essence), then debunking an essentialist claim historically (or vice versa) commits a category error — yet Burke himself uses anthropological discrediting of Freud's primal horde as evidence the claim was really about essence. The convertibility seems asymmetric: essence claims survive existential discrediting more readily than existence claims survive essentialist re-reading.

Burke claims the dramatistic perspective must abolish itself in its own enunciation, yet the entire Grammar (and Rhetoric and Symbolic) is built on dramatism's continuing applicability. Is the self-abolition a one-time event, a recurring discovery, or a built-in limit-condition that one continually approaches but never reaches?

The closing 'Neo-Liberal Ideal' is an attitude of speculative tolerance and linguistic skepticism, aimed at the 'purification of war.' Yet dramatism's central insight is that motive-statements ALWAYS feature one term — there is no neutral pentad. Can a 'neo-Stoic' attitude that purports to stand above warring motivational vocabularies avoid being itself one more featured terminology?

literary_examples.work: Coleridge — Ancient Mariner / Theory of Life / Biographia (passim)
literary_examples.role: Polarity vocabulary; insects-and-flowers as merger-atop-division; inter res heterogeneas formula.
Identity-of-Othello-in-jealousy as worked case of dialectical desynonymizing; Iago as consubstantial dialectical opposite; Cassio as scenic alienation.
The chapter's central worked dialectical text: five-level reading of the dialogue's structure as itself an act of transcendence.
Burke's dialectical-historical reading: dissolution of tribal homogeneity → idealistic reconstitution → Benthamite legislation.
Central worked case of temporizing of essence: Peer's search for his true self as 'going back' to the maternal origin; Solveig as spiritualized mother; Christ-child Annunciation pattern.

literary_examples.work: Ibsen — Wild Duck / Enemy of the People / Love's Comedy / Brand
literary_examples.role: Dialectical-shift exhibition in Ibsen's oeuvre (reformer-from-without flipped to reformer-from-opponents'-standpoint).
Essayistic culmination of temporizing essence; involuntary-memory moments linked outside time by idealized synthesizing quality.
Tadzio scene as modern recurrence of Phaedrus 'corruption-as-saving-of-souls'; transcendence of homosexuality / homosexuality of transcendence ambiguity.
Annunciation 'through the hollow of an ear' as Christian-symbolic recurrence of Platonic verbal insemination.
Ahab pursued by the white whale he pursues — consubstantiality of attacker and victim.
Volcano erupting at moment of plot's maximum agitation — exemplifying a state of scene-act conformity without cause-effect.

cross_pipeline_bridges.notes: Calleja's six PIM dimensions can each be read as merger/division moves on the player-environment pair; incorporation itself is Burke's merger applied at the player-world juncture. The dissertation builds this bridge from outside both authors (Burke=0 Calleja, Calleja=0 Burke).

cross_pipeline_bridges.to: Aristotle — per genus et differentiam (Topics, Metaphysics)
cross_pipeline_bridges.notes: Burke directly cites Aristotle's definition of man on book p.410; the dramatic-unities digression also exegetes Aristotle's Poetics (lost epic-section). Strongest exegetical anchor in the chapter.

Burke 1945 has zero Heidegger hits (Phase 0 verified); the convergence of temporizing-of-essence with Heideggerian temporality (Gewesenheit, the having-been) is parallel-discovery, not influence. Manual Section E will tag accordingly.
Neurath's synusia (book p.411) — 'living being and the environment' as merger — is the closest in-text approach to a biosemiotic Umwelt picture. Burke=0 Uexküll hits; parallel-discovery only.

cross_pipeline_bridges.to: Burke — Rhetoric of Motives (1950, future pipeline)
cross_pipeline_bridges.notes: The 1962 Addendum proposing Attitude as a 6th term is the explicit forward-anchor to A Rhetoric of Motives (which formalizes identification/consubstantiation, both implicit in the scapegoat subsection of GM-09).
Burke explicitly notes 'enactments survive as constitutions' (book p.420) — direct intra-volume bridge to GM-08.
The paradox of substance is recapitulated as a dialectical staple; Stance-family + Power-family vocabulary explicitly invoked.
Temporizing-of-essence = synecdoche operating dialectically (part/whole = origin/essence); distinction-becomes-contrast = metonymy/synecdoche threshold.

ocr_notes.issues: None observed across the 43-page range. The Otto Bell name on book p.405 / 415 is unproblematic; the Latin tags (entia praeter necessitatem non esse multiplicanda, entium varietates non temere esse minuendas, inter res heterogeneas non datur oppositio) extract cleanly with diacritic-less letters.

phase3_handles.philosophic_school_mapping: Light chapter for school-mapping; Plato/Socrates anchor mysticism-purpose forward link via transcendence; Kant anchors back to idealism-agent GM-05.
phase3_handles.four_tropes_manual: Temporizing-of-essence is synecdoche; distinction-becomes-contrast is the metonymy-synecdoche threshold; scapegoat involves all four tropes operating jointly (esp. metonymy: iniquity transferred-by-contiguity onto vessel; synecdoche: vessel-as-essence-of-evil; irony: ironic-distance enabling alienation; metaphor: charismatic vicar).
